hypothesis: The frozen SL03 selective consolidation mechanism preserves causal competence on previously unseen interventions after unlabeled A→B→A return without increasing confident errors, when challenged by independent conventional hidden-context and matched-information controls.

ABC_capacity.hidden_phases: A 0-19, B 20-39, distinct C 40-63 (three contexts exceeding two-bank capacity)

world: Synthetic four-bit state, four physical causal actions. A and B use HC11 seed-dependent (sign and slope) Boolean effect rules, B is inverted A. C uses independent action-dependent affine/majority rule family from different seeded RNG; no learner receives phase or world function. OOD cubic is int(state==15) xor action sign.
physical_actions: One shared physical trajectory per world: action (seed+step)%4 except at steps [5,13,21,29,37,45,53,61], which are paid exogenous bit flips (seed//4+step//8)%4. Eight flips cost physical actions and are never fitted. 64 total physical steps/world, 56 causal observations/world.
common_information: Every arm sees only identical ordered paid physical observations; no oracle, no evaluator audit feedback, no direct access to seed/group/true regime. Memory of past events capped at 48 physical causal tuples in SL03 and competitors. Fixed rest/observer boundaries after steps 8,16,24,32,40,48,56,64.
arms: frozen_sl03_selective_sleep (unchanged SL03 Learner selective_sleep, imported by path pinned to source)
sl03_conventional_selective (unchanged SL03 conventional_selective_sleep, independent rule implementation)

conventional_hmm_masks (independently coded two-bank finite-state HMM-style online change detector with exact 40-rule/action version spaces, 320 logical mask bits plus two posterior confidence scores; never access true context)
conventional_recent_window (simple strongest-recent-rule-version-space baseline, 48-event FIFO; report conditional abstentions)
HMM_protocol: Two hypothesis banks, 40-rule masks per action each. Introduce second bank after first contradiction; use pre-update contextual prediction mismatch to switch into alternate bank if that bank remains consistent, otherwise new bank only if unused, else flag mismatch and abstain. Maintain a bounded public transition mismatch counter with hazard=1/16 and prequential predictive likelihood from the uniform rule mask, to decide when changing active mode; hard masks retained. This is HMM-style but not full BOCPD and is disclosed as such.
recent_window_protocol: Independent conventional 40-rule/action version-space predictor fitted only to the last 12 causal events per action within a maximum 48-event physical FIFO, no context labels. Conflicting evidence causes abstention; never access evaluator truth.
inference: Abstain if evidence does not resolve unanimous next-state, mismatch unresolved, or context ambiguous. No evaluation labels leak to training. Prequential charged causal predictions and evaluator-only exhaustive 16 state x 4 actions at steps 20,40,64 (final 512 queries/cohort); never-trained query subset reported. Cold restore and tamper tests.
comparison_limits: Matched physical actions/observations, same fixed rule grammar for relevant arms, capped 2x4x40 mask logical bits for dual-bank, 48-event bounded stream for all. HMM adds two float confidence scores; report actual snapshots/cpu time. Whole-process compute and capacity not exactly equal; no scientific PASS until matched-cost independent qualification.

primary.classification: DEV_SIGNAL only if all criteria pass; otherwise MIXED_DEV for correctness gain but safety failure, NEGATIVE_DEV for no gain, INVALID for leakage/mismatched physical budgets

boundaries: Source-only external draft, no merge/accepted model/loop/controller, no protected science first-use, no live deployment, no unrelated project modifications. No tokens, gradient training or paid API; all evidence in GitHub repo, no ChatGPT file attachments.
